frontmatter.title: Wire eidos spawn <docket-id> (promote to child eidos)

task.body: Convenes a Pod (or Solo per cardinality contract) to deliberate the child eidos's telos and active forge set, then creates the child at <eidos_home>/.eidos/children/<child-id>/.eidos/. Child inherits parent's anti-goals; member repos default to parent's; forge set deliberated fresh.

telos.statement: Ship eidos-cli v1.0 — the unified agent CLI for the Eidos scope architecture, per THE-EIDOS doctrine and ADR-007
success_when: eidos define/enter/status/activate/close work end-to-end with the four-field telos contract gate
eidos research/governor/docket/praxis namespaces route to the five forge libraries
eidos mcp serve boots a razor-thin help-only MCP server
eidos migrate consolidates legacy .telos/.research/.governor/.docket/.hone into a single .eidos/ idempotently
eidos spawn promotes a docket item to a child eidos
eidos tick emits drift classification against the telos triggers
failure_when: doctrine in THE-EIDOS and code in eidos-cli diverge silently
the migration corrupts existing consumer state
Solo-default is bypassed in favor of unconditional Pod-default
success_when_not: duplicates the five forge libraries' internal logic
couples eidos to a single LLM provider
imposes ceremony on tasks an AI can do in one pass
